title: Data and Applications
blurb: Databases from the ground up for the endsem on 23 Nov: the relational model, ER/EER design and mapping, normalisation, relational algebra, tuple relational calculus and SQL. Built from Elmasri and Navathe 7e, this year's six assignments with Kamal's keys and rubrics, and last year's papers.

docs.title: Start here: the endsem map
docs.about: Exam rules, syllabus to textbook sections to assignments, the full exercise list, and a plan up to the exam

docs.title: Videos and quick checks
docs.about: A lecture and a problem-solving video for each endsem topic, plus one worked problem per topic in Kamal's style

docs.title: Chapter 0: Database concepts and architecture
docs.about: Elmasri chapters 1 and 2: the database approach, users, DBMS advantages, data models, schemas and states, three-schema architecture, data independence, languages and client/server tiers; exercises 1.1 to 2.14

docs.title: Chapter 1: The relational model, keys and constraints
docs.about: Relations, superkeys and candidate keys, counting superkeys, integrity constraints, update operations and violations

docs.title: Chapter 2: ER and EER modelling
docs.about: Entities, attributes, relationships, (min, max), weak entities, ternary relationships, specialization and categories; Assignment 2

docs.title: Chapter 3: Mapping EER to relations
docs.about: The seven mapping steps, specialization options 8A to 8D, categories, and the Assignment 3 rubric

docs.title: Chapter 4: Functional dependencies and normalisation
docs.about: Closure, keys, 1NF to BCNF, minimal cover, BCNF decomposition, 3NF synthesis, lossless join and dependency preservation; Assignment 4

docs.title: Chapter 5: Relational algebra
docs.about: Selection, projection, joins, set operations, division, aggregates and outer joins; Assignment 5 and Elmasri 8.15 to 8.22

docs.title: Chapter 6: Tuple relational calculus
docs.about: Tuple variables, free and bound variables, quantifiers, universal queries via NOT EXISTS, safety; Elmasri 8.24 to 8.29

docs.title: Chapter 7: SQL
docs.about: DDL and constraints, SELECT, NULLs, nested and correlated queries, EXISTS, joins, GROUP BY and HAVING, views, stored procedures; Assignment 6 and past papers

docs.title: Mock endsem with solutions
docs.about: A full paper in this year's style, with worked answers and what an A needs

docs.title: Two-page cheat sheet
docs.about: What to copy onto your two handwritten A4 sheets
